panels.headline: Mayor of Tiny Walks
panels.body: Recovery, one step (and soup) at a time.
panels.art_direction: Cinematic single-object cover with a centered steaming bowl of soup resting on a soft basil-green field. Lower third reserved for clean text-safe area. panels.headline: For the Mayor
panels.body: The city of small steps sends its regards. Your streets are quiet, but your sidewalks are lined with basil and better soup every day.
panels.art_direction: Ornate border-first stationery layout with thin refined frame in basil green. Quiet center in warm ivory with generous margins. Sparse motifs: one basil sprig in lower-left corner, two striped hospital socks peeking from lower-right. Light, paper-like texture. Typography area centered, unobstructed.

panels.headline: One bowl, one step, one day
panels.body: I hope the soup’s been five stars lately, and the socks haven’t staged a coup. Your garden’s waiting—only basil, as always—and so are the sidewalks you’ve sworn to patrol. Take your time. The city needs its mayor, but not in a hurry. Just when you’re ready.
panels.art_direction: Matching border-first stationery to inside-left, same thin basil-green frame and warm ivory center. Lower edge: a winding path of tiny footprints leading from left to right, fading gently. One floating basil leaf mid-path. Generous margins, low-contrast background, no central obstruction. Typography area fully reserved.
